units.title: Basics of Power semiconduct or Devices
topics: 1.1. Introduction to power electronics, History of Power Electronics Development. Applications of power electronics: Power electronics in Information technology, robotics and flexible production, role of power electronics in providing sustainable electric energy- Energy conversation, Electric- Motor Driven Systems, Lighting, Transportation, Renewable Energy and Utility Applications of Power Electronics
1.2. Semiconductor devices: Diode, Thyristor family (DIAC,SCR,LASCR,ASCR,RCT, GTO,SITH,MCT,TRIAC,SCS,SUS,SBS), Transistor family (BJT, MOSFET, IGBT, SIT, PUT, UJT)- symbol, maximum ratings.

topics: 5.1. SCR Protection:  Main power circuit: di/dt, dv/dt, over current, over voltage, snubber circuit.  Gate circuit: Gate circuit protection using Zener diode. 5b Explain different types of MOSFET protection.

5.2. MOSFET Protection: overvoltage, over current, Gate protection. 5c Describe Thyristor ratings. 5.3 Thyristor ratings:  Voltage ratings: Peak working forward- blocking voltage (VDWM), Peak repetitive forward blocking voltage (VDRM), Peak working reverse voltage (VRWM), Peak repetitive reverse voltage (VRRM), Voltage safety factor, finger voltage, on state voltage drop.  Current ratings: Average On-State current, RMS On-State current, holding and lathing current. 5d Describe MOSFET ratings. 5.4 MOSFET ratings:  Breakdown voltage, maximum on state voltage, Maximum Gate voltage, maximum continuous current, switching time and average power dissipation, on state resistance.
